background_image_description: A minimalist close-up of a light gray, off‑white textured surface that fills the frame, resembling fine-grain paper or stucco. The composition is flat and uniform, with soft lighting revealing subtle speckles.

nodes.asset_description: A single slender stem with glossy, oval green leaves arcs diagonally across a soft sage-green gradient background. The minimalist, studio-style composition uses ample negative space and gentle lighting to highlight the leaves’ smooth texture and veins.

A minimalist botanical illustration shows slender eucalyptus-like leaves in deep and sage greens on thin stems. The branch sweeps diagonally across a soft white-to-pale green gradient background with ample negative space.
